item.title: Warren Beatty and Annette Bening's former Beverly Hills home lists for $14.995 million
item.description: The iconic Beverly Hills residence of Warren Beatty and Annette Bening is now available for nearly 15 million dollars. Initially acquired for 6.7 million dollars in 2012, extensive renovations worth 5 million dollars have modernized its Mediterranean allure. Among its features are a custom home theater repurposed from the original office and a range of outdoor amenities, making it a perfect retreat steeped in cinematic history.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Art collector Agnes Gund's collection brought in $25.7 million at a New York auction to benefit her charitable foundation; a portrait she called her Mona Lisa fetched $1.1 million, setting an artist record
item.description: Agnes Gund's remarkable auction of her art collection amassed an impressive $25.7 million, all directed toward her charitable foundation. Among the highlights was a record-setting painting by Jim Nutt. With initiatives like the Art for Justice Fund, her philanthropy champions criminal justice reform and underscores her unwavering dedication to both art and educational accessibility.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Wyoming court upholds $101,232 award in dispute over family ranch and proposed hospital sale
item.description: A family ranch battle among three siblings resulted in serious legal challenges. The dispute revolved around access paths and a failed sale of a hospital. Suellen Davidson's involvement disrupted her siblings' agreement with Platte Valley Healthcare Project. The Wyoming Supreme Court confirmed a damages award for this interference, illustrating the complexities faced in family property disputes that intertwine personal relationships with business transactions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Goldie Hawn joins 1,700 at Atlanta luncheon raising $1.08m for women and girls
item.description: The 30th annual Numbers Too Big To Ignore Luncheon in Atlanta successfully raised over $1 million, benefitting various community programs. Goldie Hawn shared her insights on parenting, kindness, and children's mental health, highlighting how adults significantly impact young lives. The event featured generous contributions from attendees and a matching donation from The Coca-Cola Foundation, with proceeds directed towards enhancing opportunities for women and girls in the metro Atlanta area.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A British shopper paid just £20 for a painting at a charity shop, then an expert identified it as a 160-year-lost Nicholas Chevalier landscape; it is now expected to fetch up to £20,000 at a December auction
item.description: A British shopper found a painting attributed to 19th-century artist Nicholas Chevalier for only £20 in a charity shop. After purchase, the buyer sought an expert's opinion which confirmed the painting's significance. The artwork, named Cape Schanck, Victoria, had been lost for around 160 years. This discovery reconnects the painting with Chevalier's historical records, offering a glimpse into his artistic process.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Atlanta's abandoned prison farm, with crumbling buildings and a former zoo-animal cemetery, could become a public park and memorial; the city has unveiled plans but must first relocate a bomb range
item.description: Atlanta is set to transform the historic prison farm site into a public park and memorial. The project aims to preserve the history of forced labor while creating green spaces for the community. Proposed features include walking trails, a museum, and educational facilities for visitors. The city faces challenges, including relocating a bomb detonation range on the property.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mansion Relisted At $38.495 Million: Jenner relists estate; nearly $10 million below original price
item.description: Kylie Jenner's Holmby Hills mansion has returned to the market at a new asking price of $38.495 million, down from its previous listing of $48 million over a year ago. After purchasing the estate for $36.5 million in 2020, this marks her third attempt to find a buyer. The luxurious property boasts numerous amenities, including a basketball court and a home theatre, showcasing a blend of elegance and entertainment.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: The Conservation Fund protects North America's largest gathering site of Pacific walruses
item.description: As climate change continues to threaten the Pacific walrus population, significant steps have been taken to protect their habitat. A 47,473-acre conservation easement around Point Lay, Alaska, has been established to minimize human impact during walrus haul-outs. This initiative not only safeguards these mammals but also allows local Indigenous communities to retain access to vital resources, symbolizing a harmonious balance between conservation and community needs.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: A firefly not seen since 1983 has been found again after scientist recognised its amber flashes
item.description: Exciting news emerged in 2026 when a firefly, thought to have vanished since 1983, was rediscovered in Delaware and Virginia. Its unique amber flash patterns caught the attention of researchers, confirming its survival. Habitat loss is suspected to have led to its absence from earlier records. Community engagement significantly aided in this rediscovery, prompting further surveys to assess the firefly's population and habitat requirements.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: San Francisco mansion resells for $24M after five months
item.description: A five-bedroom mansion in Presidio Heights sold for $24 million after a previous purchase of $21 million. The property was originally listed in June and returned to the market in November at $19.9 million. It was sold within three days of being re-listed due to high demand for luxury homes. The house spans 8,000 square feet and features extensive renovations while preserving its original craftsmanship.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: A teenage girl found headless in a Northern Ireland bog in 2023 died up to 2,300 years ago, and a mock coroner’s inquest in Belfast has now pieced together her height, diet and how she was struck
item.description: Recent findings of the Ballymacombs More Woman's remains in a Northern Ireland bog are unlocking fascinating details about her life in the Iron Age, circa 343 BCE to 1 BCE. An in-depth analysis reveals she suffered a violent decapitation, likely part of a ritualistic act. Such research is crucial as it provides a greater understanding of the social and cultural practices of ancient communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: In 1884, an Erie family built a Queen Anne mansion; 142 years later, the 360,000-pound home has been restored after a seven-hour move and renamed for the businessman who rescued it, with a university now leasing it
item.description: The Olds-Norman House, a historic mansion built in 1884, was rescued from the wrecking ball and moved 250 feet in Erie, Pennsylvania. Now called the Thomas B. Hagen House, it’s found a new life thanks to Gannon University. This Queen Anne-style beauty has witnessed a lot over the years and is now being preserved for future generations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Scientists find 156-million-year-old horned reptile fossil in Wyoming sandstone
item.description: A remarkable discovery in Wyoming has unearthed a fossil of a diminutive dinosaur-like creature, dating back 156 million years to the Jurassic era. Advanced imaging techniques uncovered this skeleton entombed in sandstone. Researchers classify it as an early reptilian branch, enhancing our understanding of evolutionary history. Analysis indicates it inhabited freshwater environments and may have fallen prey to a larger predator.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Texas inheritance fight over ranches, yacht and millions leads to asset freeze limits
item.description: A high-stakes inheritance battle in Texas involves Lonnie K. Ledbetter Jr.'s significant estate, featuring sprawling ranches and luxury cars. Following the Texas Second Court of Appeals ruling, assets have been temporarily frozen, impacting his wife, Tawni Ledbetter. Disputes continue over Lonnie's mental capacity during key document signings, while some assets await judicial clarification. A court-appointed receiver will oversee daily expenses and management as the case progresses.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: NY court rejects 3 brothers’ bid for access across sibling’s farm
item.description: Four New York brothers who jointly ran a family farm ended up in court after their business relationship broke down. An appeals court rejected three brothers' demand for a route through their sibling's land, finding they had failed to prove it was essential to reach their gravel pit and timber areas. The court also upheld the decision to award their brother a 1988 Chevrolet Suburban under their property settlement.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: California drone operator spots great white near swimmer and alerts fisherman to danger
item.description: While fishing off the California coast, a fisherman faced a frightening close call with a great white shark. Oblivious to the danger lurking below, he was saved when a drone operator spotted the shark and warned him. The struggling fish near the boat likely caught the predator's interest. Such encounters underline the need for heightened awareness among water enthusiasts in the ocean's depths.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
